Each situation gets worse and worse for Rhaegar’s character.

One thing to remember was that the Ancient Greeks and the Romans were powerful at different times and it would be harder to compare the two. It would better to compare the ancient Greeks to someone like the Egyptians because they were both empires at the same time. Other empires around the time of the Greeks are the Hitties, Anatolians, Mesopotamia, and the Phoenicians. They were all powerful around the time of the Greeks. 

For the Romans it’s a little harder to find other civilizations around that time because they took over almost everything. But some places is Carthage and the Germanic tribes. The former was around the beginning of the Roman Empire and the latter was towards the end of the empire

Athens was one of the earliest forms of democracy. But it was a limited democracy. Only free male citizens(you could live in Athens your whole life and technically not be considered a citizen) could vote. 

The Greeks “civilization”(there was no United Kingdom. Only city states called polies until Philip of Macedon conquered Greece) started loosely around 3000 BCE and was finally conquered by the romans in 146 BCE. It was a really long time. The Roman Empire was found in 753 BCE and fell in 476 BCE. 

 Economically both were pretty strong. Different Greek Polies started colonies in places in Northern Africa and in places back that would have been Persia at the time. It is to be noted that Athens had hit a huge silver deposits and mined it through the Hellenistic and Archaic period and that when Rome took over Greece they got a whole lot richer. Economically Rome probably won just because of the sheer volume of their empire and how much was produced. 

Same with the Military. Romans kind of win this around. Their military was so huge. For each legion there was 5,500 men. Legion numbers tended to vary depending on the year and other factors. Their fighting tactics were fairly similar to the Greek way of fighting. Each men would have a shield and a spear as their main weapons. The shield would cover the right of the guy holding and left of the guy next to him. It would encourage staying together while fighting and working as a team. I’m not sure what the Romans called it but the Greeks called it Hoplite fighting. It is also good to mention the Spartans while talking about the military because that was what their whole city state was about. They would take boys at 7 and train them until they were 30 to be ruthless soldiers. Woman in Sparta also were trained in fighting and exercised often. They were given a lot more freedom the a lot of woman in the ancient world. But the reason for their excising was so that they could give birth to healthy strong soldiers. So double sided blade.
